finding.title: Fix testing-guide.md's copy-paste test examples — they import AppDatabase/CompletionsCompanion/UserMode, all deleted in the schema-v1 rebuild

evidence.quote:
/// Write methods ([insertCompletion], [insertCompletionsBatch]) have been
/// removed.  New completions are written exclusively through

finding.why: testing-guide.md is required reading (index.md step 5) and its 'How to Write a Unit Test', 'How to Write a Widget Test', 'How to Write a Story Acceptance Test', 'How to Write an Integration Test' sections, plus the 'Test Infrastructure Details' section that quotes test/helpers/test_database.dart verbatim, all use `AppDatabase`/`CompletionsCompanion.insert(...)`/`db.completionDao.insertCompletion(...)`/`UserMode` — every one of which was deleted in the schema-v1 rebuild (the DB class is now UserDatabase in core/database/user/user_database.dart; the `completions` table and CompletionDao's write methods were removed outright per the DAO's own doc comment; UserMode was replaced by ProfileMode in core/domain/value_objects/). A contributor or AI agent copy-pasting the guide's primary teaching example gets an immediate compile failure against a non-existent API surface — the exact opposite of what a 'how to write a test' doc should do. The quoted 'test/helpers/test_database.dart' snippet is also simply not what that file contains today.
finding.recommendation: Rewrite all four code samples and the Test Infrastructure Details snippet against the current UserDatabase/CompletionEventDao/CompletionWriter/ProfileMode APIs; also refresh the '531+ tests across 167 files' and '14 epic tags and 62 story tags' counts (actual: dart_test.yaml has 20 epic tags / 97 story tags, and ~10,353 test()/testWidgets() calls across 780 files, per test-options.md's already-accurate figure).
acceptance_criteria: every code block in testing-guide.md compiles against current lib/ (spot-checked by pasting into a scratch test file)
epic/story tag counts and the test_database.dart snippet match dart_test.yaml and test/helpers/test_database.dart

finding.title: Update linear-status.md — Epics 25-27 marked 'all Backlog' despite dozens of implemented, non-skipped story-acceptance tests

evidence.quote: 35 stories. Eight feature areas reorganized to consume the new core.
17 stories (16 Backlog, 1 Canceled). Test pyramid, CI gates, observability, docs.

finding.why: linear-status.md (self-dated 'last reconciled 2026-05-13', ~7 weeks stale relative to the audit date) states all of Epic 25 (22 stories), Epic 26 (35 stories) and Epic 27 (17 stories) are 'Backlog'. But test/story_acceptance/ already contains 31 distinct epic_25/26/27 story-numbered test files (e.g. epic_25_story_25_20_locale_theme_test.dart, epic_26_story_26_7_dashboard_model_provider_test.dart, epic_27_story_14_analytics_test.dart) totaling well over 150 test groups with a single `skip:` marker among them — i.e. these are live, executing acceptance suites, not scaffolded placeholders. Anyone using this doc to plan work risks re-scoping or re-implementing stories that already shipped.
finding.recommendation: Re-sync against status/sprint-status.yaml (the doc's own stated source of truth) and, as a cheap proxy check going forward, cross-reference `grep -L 'skip:' test/story_acceptance/epic_2[567]_*.dart` against the Backlog list before publishing a status doc.
acceptance_criteria: Epic 25/26/27 story statuses in linear-status.md match sprint-status.yaml
no story shown 'Backlog' has a fully un-skipped acceptance test file in test/story_acceptance/

evidence.quote:

finding.why: open-items.md's C1 entry describes a state from before the Epic 24-27 rebuild (it even cites 'schema v20', a version number from the pre-rebuild numbering that was reset to v1 during the rebuild). finding.title: Resolve or delete product-rules.md's stale Q-Term item — the UserMode.parent→adult rename already shipped and is DB-enforced

evidence.quote: - **Q-Term.** Code-side `UserMode.parent` → `adult` rename — bundled with Stream C or separate cleanup pass.

finding.why: product-rules.md's own maintenance policy states 'When a rule is changed or retired, this doc MUST be updated.' Q-Term is listed under 'Open product decisions... pending owner', but the `UserMode` enum no longer exists anywhere in lib/ (confirmed by repo-wide grep) and learner_profiles.mode has carried a DB-level CHECK constraint permitting only 'adult'|'child' since schema v26 (WS9). The decision was made and enforced; the doc still presents it as unresolved, which could cause someone to re-litigate or re-plan work that's already done. (Every other concrete code claim in this doc — CompletionSource, MarkCompletionUseCase, kPaceGraceWindowDays, ProgressTierCounterRow.showPoints, HebrewCalendarUtils.formatEnglishDate, useHebrewTermsProvider's confinement to core/labels+core/preferences+onboarding/settings screens — was verified accurate, so this is an isolated miss, not a pattern.)
finding.recommendation: Move Q-Term from 'Open product decisions' to a resolved/closed note (mirroring how Q-S1/Q-A/Q-W/Q-IA/Q-G are already struck through above it in the same section).
acceptance_criteria: Q-Term is marked decided/closed or removed from the open list

finding.title: Remove test-options.md's reference to tool/device_e2e/night_runner.py — the file does not exist in the repo

evidence.quote:
- `night_runner.py` — continuous soak loop; self-cleans each iteration
    (deletes its test account/data/token).

finding.why: test-options.md lists night_runner.py as an existing 'piece' of the on-device E2E harness alongside driver.py, journey_01_signup_profile.py and README.md — all three of which do exist. `find . -iname 'night_runner*'` across the whole repo returns nothing. The rest of this doc (layer table, CI job list, ~10,000-test count, test/e2e|sync|overflow paths) was verified accurate, so this single fabricated-sounding entry stands out and would send someone looking for a soak-test script that was never committed (or was planned and never built).
finding.recommendation: Either remove the night_runner.py bullet or, if it's planned work, reword it as 'planned: a continuous soak loop is not yet built' to match the doc's own honest framing elsewhere ('one journey proven; full per-screen coverage builds out journey-by-journey').
acceptance_criteria: test-options.md only lists tool/device_e2e/ files that exist, or explicitly marks planned-but-unbuilt ones as such
